title: Badkobeh and Ochem's Word b5: Interval-Exchange Coding, Factor Complexity 4n + 1, Projections, and Critical Exponent

Comput. Sci. 588, 2015) for the 5-letter morphic fixed point b5 = f5^omega(0) (0 -> 01, 1 -> 23, 2 -> 4, 3 -> 21, 4 -> 0). The library identifies b5 as the exact 5-interval coding of a golden-ratio 3-interval exchange on (-phi^2/2, phi^3/2) via the -1/phi left eigenvector, proving unconditionally that (Q1) b5 has exact factor complexity 4n + 1 for every n >= 0, (O1) g_fib(b5) has the exact same factors as the Fibonacci word with complexity n + 1, (O2) g_rf(b5) has the exact same factors as the Rote-Fibonacci word with complexity 2n for n >= 1, and (Q2) the critical exponent of b5 is exactly (5 + sqrt(5))/4 and is strictly unattained.
